wire_name_contract.text: At most 31 UTF-8 bytes with a terminator inside the provided source span. Raw fields retain marker zero plus NUL; compressed fields retain the existing 31-byte codec budget.
wire_name_contract.output: Ship-design encoding accepts an actual byte span and returns an optional byte count. Failed encoding leaves the destination unchanged. Stream publication and pure encoding are separate operations.
wire_name_contract.callers: Real log, race, library and save callers plus actual test consumers migrate; old raw-pointer/cursor overloads removed. No production player-record caller used external storage.
